snapshot.text: Oil-funded public system with large investments in hospitals but weak primary care. The government plans a specialised agency to run the hospital system and has a Vision 2030 strategy to eliminate malaria.

priorities.title: Hospital management agency
priorities.text: A specialised agency is to take over management of the hospital system.

priorities.title: Malaria elimination by 2030
priorities.text: A Vision 2030 strategy to eliminate malaria, including on Bioko island.
